caseNameFull: James F. Taylor v. United States
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. R. E. Milling and Mr. E. H. Randolph for appellants., Mr. Assistant Attorney General Kearful for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam. Mr. R. E. Milling and Mr. E. H. Randolph for appellants. Mr. Assistant Attorney General Kearful for the United States.

Judgment affirmed upon the authority of Washington Securities Co. v. United States, 234 U. S. 76, 78; Wright-Blodgett Co. v. United States, 236 U. S. 397, 402-405; Linn & Lane Timber Co. v. United States, 236 U. S. 574, 575, 576.
